mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.parent_comment_id, CASE WHEN c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE c.content END AS content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, (c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS deleted, u.username, u.display_name, pc.id AS reply_to_comment_id, pc.user_id AS reply_to_user_id, pu.username AS reply_to_username, pu.display_name AS reply_to_display_name, (pc.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS reply_to_deleted FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN comments pc ON pc.id = c.parent_comment_id LEFT JOIN users pu ON pu.id = pc.user_id
mapper.select: WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, user_id, parent_comment_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET content = #{content}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE comments SET deleted_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
